His eyes are fixed on a point in front of him, and the lighting highlights the texture of his skin and the tattoos on his neck. The background remains consistent with weights and industrial-style gym decor. (8) The final sequence alternates between a close-up of the black-shirted man looking solemn and a wider shot of both men sitting silently on the machine, reflecting on the conversation. The lighting is bright and even across the gym floor.
